newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: United Chemical to buy Hongkew.
newsitem.headline: United Chemical to buy Hongkew.

text.p: United Chemical Industries Bhd (UCI) said on Monday it will acquire a 100 interest in Hongkew Holdings (M) Sdn Bhd for 450 million ringgit.

The company said in a statement that it had entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Sungei Wang Properties Sdn Bhd to acquire the entire issued and paid-up share capital of Hongkew comprising 19 million ordinary shares of one ringgit each, the national Bernama news agency said.
UCI officials could not be reached for comment. The company makes polypropylene and polyethylene woven bags, and its stock has been suspended since Sept 9 at the company's request.
The proposed acquisition will allow the company to diversify into cement manufacturing and port operations.

United Chemical said the initial and second payments totalling 50 million ringgit for the purchase consideration would be financed from bank borrowings and possibly through a private placement of new UCI shares.
The funding of the balance sum of 400 million ringgit would be structured at a later stage.
